Every operation Vibium supports (230 in all) and its form on each
surface. An empty cell means the surface has no equivalent. The source
is the [API spec](https://github.com/VibiumDev/vibium/blob/main/docs/reference/api.md) in the main repository, which CI checks
against the binary and all three clients.

Operations marked **(nightly)** are not in the latest release (26.8.21).
The same data is published as [`/api.json`](/api.json). Per-language
views: [JavaScript](../libraries/javascript/api.md),
[Python](../libraries/python/api.md), [Java](../libraries/java/api.md).

## Browser

| Operation | CLI | MCP | JavaScript | Python | Java |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Launch browser and connect | `vibium start` | `browser_start` | `browser.start(opts?)` | `browser.start(opts?)` | `Vibium.start(options?)` |
| Get the default page |  |  | `browser.page()` | `browser.page()` | `browser.page()` |
| Create a new page | `vibium page new` | `browser_new_page` | `browser.newPage()` | `browser.new_page()` | `browser.newPage()` |
| Create a new browser context |  |  | `browser.newContext()` | `browser.new_context()` | `browser.newContext()` |
| List all pages | `vibium pages` | `browser_list_pages` | `browser.pages()` | `browser.pages()` | `browser.pages()` |
| Stop the browser | `vibium stop` | `browser_stop` | `browser.stop()` | `browser.stop()` | `browser.stop()` |
| Listen for new page events |  |  | `browser.onPage(cb)` | `browser.on_page(cb)` | `browser.onPage(cb)` |
| Listen for popup events |  |  | `browser.onPopup(cb)` | `browser.on_popup(cb)` | `browser.onPopup(cb)` |
| Remove all event listeners |  |  | `browser.removeAllListeners(ev?)` | `browser.remove_all_listeners(ev?)` | `browser.removeAllListeners(ev?)` |
| Get the default context **(nightly)** |  |  |  |  | `browser.context()` |

## Element

| Operation | CLI | MCP | JavaScript | Python | Java |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Click an element | `vibium click <sel>` | `browser_click` | `el.click(opts?)` | `el.click(timeout?)` | `el.click()` |

| Press a key on focused element | `vibium press <key>` | `browser_press` | `el.press(key, opts?)` | `el.press(key, timeout?)` | `el.press(key)` |
| Clear an input field |  |  | `el.clear(opts?)` | `el.clear(timeout?)` | `el.clear()` |

| Select a dropdown option | `vibium select <sel> <val>` | `browser_select` | `el.selectOption(val, opts?)` | `el.select_option(val, timeout?)` | `el.selectOption(val)` |
| Hover over an element | `vibium hover <sel>` | `browser_hover` | `el.hover(opts?)` | `el.hover(timeout?)` | `el.hover()` |

| Get element outer HTML | `vibium html <sel>` | `browser_get_html` | `el.html()` | `el.html()` | `el.html()` |
